title: Malicious SHA-256 file hash d8e47c699b68… (OffSeq Mirage)
description: A malicious file identified by the SHA-256 hash d8e47c699b68eac208cb265deb82902f613cee0391549f14f94f1c3305b6fb93 was observed twice on November 2, 2026, by OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors. The file is associated with attacker activity involving the MITRE ATT&CK technique T1105 (Ingress Tool Transfer). The malicious payload could be a dropper, web shell, miner, or post-exploitation tool. The attacker infrastructure was located in France. This hash can be used to detect the presence of this malicious file in environments and security tools.
